basic_info.description: Located in sunny Visitation Valley, this mid-century 3-bedroom, 2-bath home is filled with natural light and offers views of the South Bay and surrounding hills. The spacious living room features hardwood floors and a corner wood-burning fireplace, while the generously sized eat-in kitchen provides a welcoming space for daily meals or entertaining. On the street level, a large room with an adjacent bathpreviously used as the primary bedroomcould easily serve as a family room with views. The expansive lower level houses the laundry area and furnace, with potential for additional storage or workspace. Excellent public transportation options and easy access to Highway 101 make this home a convenient urban retreat.
